lastTask: Implement Byte 15b-b strategy-diverse chorus critic candidates

projectState.summary: Byte 15b-b diversifies the model critic menu while preserving the Byte 15b-a safety boundary. `MelodyRepairTake` now exposes named app-owned chorus strategies (`balanced-repair`, `lifted-hook`, `stepwise-hook`, `spacious-hook`, `energetic-hook`, `cadence-hook`, plus local/raw fallbacks), each with strategy summary, note count, best-candidate id, and score deltas versus local best and deterministic fallback. The Ollama melody critic still returns only `selectedCandidateId` plus short prose; valid picks switch to the selected app-owned candidate through the existing chorus/lookahead path. Manual critic outcomes are persisted as `song.melody_critic_selection` so model choices can be compared over time.
